text:
Nia: Quick usability/a11y pass on trace export + stack controls  a few quick wins.
Omar: please list so we can triage.
Nia: 1) Export button text "Download" ambiguous. Prefer "Export trace (.zip)" when snapshots bundled.
2) On narrow headers Export is moved into "More" and becomes hard to reach with arrow keys/keyboard.
3) Correlation pill copy button is read before the id by screen readers on mobile  flip DOM order or add aria-label.
Priya: a11y specifics: copy button aria-label="Copy correlation id ab12"; announce download ready via aria-live polite.
Luis: backend currently sends filename=trace.json. We'll switch to trace-<corr>-YYYYMMDD.zip and add X-Trace-Filename header so frontend can show expected name.
Omar: analytics: emit trace.export with props {surface:"header", format:"zip", corr_id:"ab12"} and keep event name stable.
Nia: stack toggle uses "more"  ambiguous. Use "Show full stack" / "Hide full stack" and toggle aria-expanded.
Priya: add sr-only text on icon-only toggles and implement roving tabindex + arrow key nav in overflow menus.
Luis: i'll split into two PRs: frontend markup/CSS + keyboard tests; backend header change. Will request a11y review.
ci-bot: Reminder: include changelog line and request a11y label. :robot_face: 
Nia: thanks  opening PR for copy + aria now, will link backend PR in description.
